items.title: MorphAct
items.description: Scaling robot learning across diverse interactions can create conflicting update demands in shared parameters. MorphAct examines these trade-offs through operation-level diagnostics and adapts perception and action through representation-coupled parameter generation.
items.imageAlt: MorphAct method: vision-language and action parameter generators are coupled through adapted representations to adjust the policy to each interaction context.
items.imageCaption: Representation-coupled parameter generation · Method figure from the paper

items.title: Evo-Depth
items.description: A lightweight vision-language-action model that uses implicit depth cues from RGB observations to improve spatially grounded manipulation without additional depth sensors.
items.contribution: Model design, code implementation, training, and evaluation.
items.imageAlt: Evo-Depth architecture and progressive alignment training: implicit depth encoding, spatial enhancement, and action prediction.
items.imageCaption: Architecture and training overview · Figure 2 from the paper

items.title: Evo-Depth: A Lightweight Depth-Enhanced Vision-Language-Action Model
items.description: A lightweight VLA model that strengthens spatial perception with implicit depth cues from RGB observations, without extra depth sensors.

items.title: MorphAct: Robot Policies Morphing with the Worlds They Act In
items.description: Shows that different manipulation skills impose conflicting updates on shared policy parameters, and lets the policy generate context-dependent parameters for its perception and action modules.

items.title: MiroCap: Multi-view Human Interaction Reconstruction for Robot Loco-Manipulation Learning
items.description: Reconstructs human interactions from multi-view capture and retargets them across robot embodiments to produce training data for loco-manipulation policies.

items.company: HKU · Miro Dynamics–HKU CGVU Joint Lab
items.title: Research Assistant
items.description:
Worked on **MiroCap** and cross-embodiment action retargeting for dexterous manipulation, translating standardized interaction representations into executable robot behavior while preserving task intent, object motion, and contact structure.

Conducted research with [Prof. Taku Komura](https://i.cs.hku.hk/~taku/)’s team at HKU's School of Computing and Data Science, with guidance from [Zhouyingcheng Liao](https://zycliao.com/) and [Dr. Wenjia Wang](https://wenjiawang0312.github.io/).

items.title: Research Assistant
items.description:
Studied contextual robot policy parameterization and spatial perception. Co-first author of **MorphAct** and **Evo-Depth** (NeurIPS 2026); co-author of **Focusable Monocular Depth Estimation** (NeurIPS 2026) and **Evo-1** (CVPR 2026).

Conducted research on embodied AI and vision-language-action models at MINT Lab under the guidance of [Prof. Bo Zhao](https://soai.sjtu.edu.cn/cn/facultydetails/zzjs/zhaobo), with guidance from [Prof. Gen Li](https://www.genli.top/), [Tao Lin](https://dorayakilin.github.io/), and [Yuxin Du](https://yuxin-du-lab.github.io/).
